title: fix(ui): keep Worktrees cleanup label stable during loading
body:
## Problem and change

The Worktrees cleanup button displayed “Loading…” during an ordinary inventory read, even when no cleanup was running. When that read completed, “Clean up now” widened the right-aligned action group and moved its left edge 23.25 px on mobile.

Show the loading label only while cleanup is running. The existing owner still disables the button during inventory reads and mutations; row loading, refresh, retry, and GC admission are unchanged. The change adds no state or lifecycle machinery.

## Proof

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Existing lifecycle regression on base | Fails because “Clean up now” is absent during the held initial read |
| Worktrees lifecycle file | 26/26 pass with the fix, including pending-list retry and held-GC reconnect |
| UI typecheck and targeted lint/format | Pass |
| Independent review | No accepted P0–P2 findings |
| Production build | Base and head pass on the same host and dependency installation |
| Mobile Chromium, 300 rows, 100 ms RTT | Base/head/base CLS: 0.0007314504132017216 / 0 / 0.0007314504132017216; 3/3 pass, no errors |
| Localhost control | Base/head/base all pass with CLS 0; the fast response need not expose the transient shift |
| Startup JS / CSS | 90,890 B gzip / 39,102 B gzip on both builds; 3 JS requests and 1 CSS request |
| Chat / New Session boot JS | 1,293,882 B / 802,234 B gzip on both builds |
| Strict head-versus-base budget check | Pass; zero growth on startup, route boot, or CSS surfaces |

The RTT controls both identify `settings-section__actions` moving from `[170.765625, 215.03125, 207.234375, 38]` to `[147.515625, 215.03125, 230.484375, 38]`. The fixed head records no layout shift. This is a structural layout proof, not a timing or speedup claim. These current-main builds are separate from the convergence census’s frozen comparison pair.

The standalone base budget check reports existing document, largest-JS, total-CSS, Chat and New Session caps; the comparative head check passes with exactly zero growth on those surfaces. No budgets were changed.

Production LOC: 329 → 327. Lifecycle test LOC: 703 → 715, with an exact 12-line allocation for the two distinct loading contracts.

## Screenshots

These are settled synthetic screenshots. The before outline and arrow annotate **recorded transient loading geometry**, not a captured pending-text frame. The settled button labels intentionally match. The after outline marks the unchanged action group; its measured loading transition has CLS 0.

![Before: settled screenshot with recorded loading bounds and 23.25 px movement](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6c9459dc-9be0-4bc1-8ade-156ea72907b6)

![After: settled screenshot with stable action bounds during loading](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/28b48323-fb24-4062-987d-e7c395c2b3e1)
